claim_being_audited: The model can be certified for launch on aggregate readiness grounds even though supporting-document checklisting for the named immigration intake context has not been evaluated yet, provided that gap is treated as an unknown/limitation and disclosed in the model card under policy.
decision_criteria: Verdict would move toward compliant if admissible evidence showed the final model card discloses the named context gap and the certification is explicitly conditioned on that disclosure.
Verdict would move toward compliant if admissible evidence showed approved risk acceptance covering launch before the evals are completed.
Verdict would move toward noncompliant if the final certification or model card still states there are no known intake limitations despite the missing evals.
Verdict would move toward compliant_with_caveats only if policy predicates are satisfied and the remaining issue is limited to ongoing monitoring rather than a missing required disclosure.
evidence_requests: Final model card or certification artifact showing the immigration intake evaluation gap is disclosed as an unknown/limitation.
Any approved risk-acceptance record, if the team intends to launch before completing the supporting-document checklisting evals.
Release decision record clarifying whether certification is conditional on disclosure versus asserting clean context coverage.
Materiality assessment showing why the missing supporting-document checklisting eval is or is not material for the named launch use case.
specific_concerns: The packet supports a conditional certification posture, not clean certification, because a named deployment-context evaluation gap remains unresolved.
There is no admissible evidence that the required model-card disclosure has actually been made before certification.
There is no admissible evidence of approved risk acceptance covering the missing context-specific evaluation.
The recommended action `certify_model` is broader than the evidence unless certification is explicitly conditioned on correcting the model-card statement and disclosing the gap.
unsupported_claims: Any unqualified claim that there are no known immigration services intake limitations.
Any claim that the named intake context is adequately covered by existing completed checks.
Any claim that policy predicates for launch are fully satisfied without either disclosure or approved risk acceptance.
